messages.content: Write one SYNTHETIC diplomatic utterance, not a quotation or reconstruction. Preserve ALL required conditions, numbers, actor roles, channel and commitment strength. Use generic we/you, not actual country names. A historical source only supplies discourse context. Do not copy unsupported historical details. Return an utterance under 65 words in a direct private negotiating-room statement style.

{"source": "We hope that relevant parties can truly bear in mind the future of their state and the fundamental interests of their people, strictly follow Resolution 2254 of the UN Security Council and the outcomes of the 4th foreign ministers' meeting of the International Syria Support Group, and seriously implement ceasefire and cessation of violence.", "synthetic_required_meaning": "We will maintain a cessation of hostilities for 2 weeks IF you maintain a cessation of hostilities for 1 weeks. Our commitment depends on yours."}
